AI Fluency: You will lead the effort to integrate production ML pipelines into the application layer, ensuring the "science fiction speed" promised in our vision is realized through optimized model serving and real-time geometry analysis. In addition, you’ll champion AI-assisted development practices across the team, actively mentoring engineers on effective use of AI tools to accelerate delivery, improve code quality, and reduce toil. Scope and Impact: You are responsible for establishing the strategic direction and leading the execution of this core integration. Collaboration and Communication: You will facilitate technical discourse across the entire Xometry organization, leading to durable, well-documented decisions. Operational Excellence: You will define the reliability and security standards for our enterprise-grade deployments, whether partner-hosted or Xometry-hosted, ensuring seamless multi-tenant management. Deep Technical Expertise: Expert-level mastery of Python, AWS infrastructure, and modern frontend frameworks (React/NextJS) used for complex enterprise applications. Systems Architect: Proven experience shaping the technical direction of multiple teams and establishing engineering patterns as organizational standards. Strategic Roadmap Execution: A track record of securing endorsement for 6-12 month initiatives and driving them to successful production deployment. Communication Excellence: The ability to influence senior leadership and external partners on technical strategy and long-term technology investments. Education: Bachelor’s in Computer Science or related field, or equivalent experience. You Would Be A Great Fit With Platform Experience: Background in building "Software as a Service" (SaaS) platforms or complex B2B integration hubs. Industrial Tech Background: Experience with manufacturing, logistics, or CAD/PLM software ecosystems. Security & Governance: Deep understanding of enterprise data controls, dedicated tenants, and SOC2/ISO compliance within a cloud environment. Distributed Systems: Experience architecting large-scale ML platforms or high-frequency marketplace engines. Our mission is to provide businesses with an advanced access control solution that ensures security, simplifies management, and enhances efficiency . Our cloud-based platform enables businesses to manage access control, intrusion detection, and video surveillance seamlessly through Alarm.com’s user-friendly web and mobile applications. With features like multi-site management, swipe to disarm, expiring access, access history reports, and bulk user management , our solution is designed to meet the evolving needs of modern businesses. Smarter Access Control is not just about security—it’s about delivering a comprehensive, integrated system that improves operational efficiency. As a Senior Software Engineer , you will play a key role in designing, developing, and optimizing robust access control solutions . You’ll collaborate with cross-functional teams, mentor junior engineers , and drive technical excellence across our platform. This is an opportunity to lead impactful projects , work with the latest technologies, and shape the future of security. Responsibilities Design and develop full-stack software solutions across a variety of platforms and technologies. Lead technical projects, making architectural decisions and ensuring scalability, security, and performance. Research, evaluate, and apply new technologies to solve complex engineering challenges. Take part in the entire development lifecycle, from requirements gathering to deployment. Balance speed and robustness—know when to iterate quickly and when to build scalable, maintainable solutions. Collaborate with cross-functional teams, including product managers, device engineers, and other software teams. Mentor junior engineers, fostering technical growth and knowledge-sharing within the team. Contribute to a culture of innovation by bringing new ideas and technical improvements to the table. Requirements Bachelor’s in Computer Science, Computer Engineering, or a related field, or equivalent work experience. 5+ years of professional software development experience. Strong object-oriented programming skills; experience with C#/.NET is a plus. Experience with database design and development (SQL Server preferred). Proficiency in developing backend services and APIs. Experience with JavaScript frameworks (Ember.js preferred). Experience with unit testing, integration testing, and CI/CD pipelines. Knowledge of distributed systems, event-driven architecture, and messaging technologies (Kafka is a plus). Experience working with IoT, hardware, or embedded systems is a plus. Why Work for Alarm.com? Collaborate with outstanding people – Work alongside talented engineers who are passionate about innovation and problem-solving. Make an immediate impact – Own projects that have a direct impact on businesses using our security solutions. Work with real-world IoT devices – See your code in action with the numerous access control and security devices we integrate with. Be empowered – Take ownership of features, drive technical decisions, and build best-in-class products. Work with the latest technologies – Our tech stack includes C#, .NET, SQL Server, Kafka, Ember.js, and mobile applications. Enjoy a strong team culture – We prioritize collaboration, professional growth, and fun, with events like hackathons, team events and company-wide celebrations. At Alarm.com, we believe in the power of technology to make security smarter and more intuitive . If you’re excited about leading innovative projects and working on mission-critical security solutions, we’d love to hear from you! Please note that sponsorship of new applicants for employment authorization, or any other immigration-related support, is not available for this position at this time. WHY WORK FOR ALARM.COM? You are empowered to perform as soon as you join the Alarm.com team! Gain well rounded experience: Alarm.com offers a diverse and dynamic environment where you will get the chance to work directly with executives and develop expertise across multiple areas of the business. Our culture is built on collaboration and connection, where we celebrate our successes and believe that a positive, engaging environment is key to doing our best work. Alarm.com values working together and collaborating in person. Our employees work from the office 4 days a week. Company Info Alarm.com is the leading platform for intelligently connected properties. Our comprehensive suite of solutions—including security, video surveillance, access control, active shooter detection, intelligent automation, energy management, and wellness—is delivered exclusively through a trusted network of thousands of professional service providers and commercial integrators across North America and worldwide. Alarm.com's common stock is traded on Nasdaq under the ticker symbol ALRM. Alarm.com delivers serious security for serious people. For more information, please visit www.alarm.com.
